_note: Dynamic GPU memory planner (tools/vramplan.py). NO fixed tiers by card size: the planner measures free VRAM at the moment a model loads and places models by priority. This file only says how important each kind of model is and a first guess of its size; real sizes are measured after the first load and remembered (.local/vram_learned.json). priority: lower number = more important, may push a higher number off the GPU. cpuSlowdown: how many times slower it runs on the CPU (bigger = worth more GPU memory). savedMs: how many ms one job saves on the GPU compared with the CPU (first guess; the planner puts the models that save the most time per MiB on the GPU first, among the live ones). canCpu false = it can only run on the GPU, so it is unloaded instead of spilled.

headroom._note: kept free for other apps' spikes and the models' working memory
